author: Susan Jenkins
text: Apply for Social Security now! The important thing to getting disability is are you 49? 49 and older have a different criteria. Also you must have a dr and tell a dr clearly what daily life activities your disability affects your ability to sustain enough energy to be gainfully employed.  I learned this from an attorney that did SS Disability appeals. If denied appeal timely. I did my sisters application and she was re evaluated but never lost benefits.
